question: What appearance and effect are attributed to the golden radiant form?
premises: The form has the splendor of heated gold.
It is described as a cause of agitation of cities and similar effects.
Appearance and effect are linked to this form.
inference: The golden radiant form causes the agitation of cities and related effects.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of the agitation of cities and the like.
